test_title: RRB NTPC - UG 2025 (CBT 1) Advanced Full Test - 01
subject: general
question:
Which of the following statements about the Ryotwari System are correct?

 
• Revenue was collected directly from the ryots (cultivators).
 
• The system was first implemented in the Bengal region.
 
• The assessment of revenue was based on the quality of soil and crop productivity.
 
• It vested proprietary rights in the ryots.
solution:
**The correct answer is option 3**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **Revenue collection directly from the ryots (cultivators):**

 
 
• Under the Ryotwari System, the government collected revenue directly from the farmers or ryots.
 
• This system eliminated the role of intermediaries, such as zamindars, in revenue collection.
 
 
 
• **Assessment based on soil quality and crop productivity:**
 
 
• Revenue was assessed based on the quality of the soil and the productivity of crops.
 
• This allowed for a more accurate and fair assessment of the tax burden on cultivators.
 
 
 
• **Proprietary rights vested in the ryots:**
 
 
• The Ryotwari System vested proprietary rights in the ryots, meaning they had ownership of the land as long as they paid the revenue to the government.
 
• This gave the ryots a sense of security and ownership over their land.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Implementation in regions:**

 
 
• The Ryotwari System was first implemented in the Madras and Bombay Presidencies, not in the Bengal region.
 
• It was later extended to other regions in South and Western India.
 
 
 
• **Comparison with other revenue systems:**
 
 
• The Zamindari System involved intermediaries (zamindars) who collected revenue from the cultivators and paid it to the government.
 
• The Mahalwari System involved the village or mahal collectively responsible for paying the revenue.
